message.content:
Build TEAMS / ORGANIZATIONS (shared account + members) for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser, currentUser } from "@/lib/auth"`; admin `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. NEW models: `Organization{ id, name, ownerId, owner(User "OrgOwner"), members(Membership[]), createdAt }`, `Membership{ id, orgId, org, userId, user, role("OWNER"|"ADMIN"|"MEMBER"|"BILLING"), createdAt }@@unique([orgId,userId])`. `User` has `ownedOrgs` + `memberships`.

## TASK
Let a customer create an organization and invite teammates by email to collaborate.
1. **Actions** `lib/actions-teams.ts` (`"use server"`): `createOrg(name)` (requireUser; creates Org + an OWNER Membership for the creator); `inviteMember(orgId, email, role)` (only OWNER/ADMIN of that org; finds the user by email — if they exist create a Membership, else return a clear "no account with that email yet" message; enforce the unique membership); `updateMemberRole(orgId, userId, role)`, `removeMember(orgId, userId)` (owner can't be removed; only OWNER/ADMIN act); `leaveOrg(orgId)`. Always verify the actor's membership/role in that org.
2. **Customer page** `app/dashboard/team/page.tsx` — `requireUser()`; shows the orgs the user owns or belongs to, a create-org form, and for orgs they administer: the member list with roles + invite form + role/remove controls. Use `components/customer/TeamManager.tsx` (`"use client"`).
3. **Admin view** `app/admin/orgs/page.tsx` (`requireArea("clients")`) — list all organizations with owner + member count (read-only overview).
Keep billing shared-membership out of scope for now (note it) — this is org + membership management. Members having access to shared servers is a follow-up; do not modify server ownership logic.

## OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
`lib/actions-teams.ts`, `app/dashboard/team/page.tsx`, `components/customer/TeamManager.tsx`, `app/admin/orgs/page.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch layouts/Shell/schema/next.config/rbac/db/auth/lib/actions.ts/worker/ROADMAP/docs/sitemap or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created; how org creation/invite/roles work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (nav links `/dashboard/team`, `/admin/orgs`; note shared-billing/shared-servers as follow-up); risks.

content.text:
All four files are created and verified against existing codebase patterns (Prisma model/relation names, primitives, CSS classes, the `useActionState`/`useTransition` form conventions, and `requireArea("clients")` gating). I'll skip a full `tsc` since other agents are editing concurrently and it would be a project-wide build.

## Report

### Files created (all owned)
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-teams.ts` — server actions (`"use server"`, all async)
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/TeamManager.tsx` — client component (`"use client"`)
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/team/page.tsx` — customer page (`requireUser()`)
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/orgs/page.tsx` — admin read-only overview (`requireArea("clients")`)

### How it works
**Org creation** — `createOrg(name)` (2–60 chars) creates the `Organization` and an `OWNER` `Membership` for the creator in one nested write. Consumed via `useActionState`.

**Invites** — `inviteMember(orgId, email, role)`: verifies the actor holds an OWNER/ADMIN membership in that org; looks the user up by normalized (lowercased) email. If no account exists it returns a clear "No account with that email yet — they need to sign up first" message (no error thrown). If found, creates the membership; the `@@unique([orgId,userId])` is guarded with an explicit "already a member" check. Invite role is restricted to ADMIN/MEMBER/BILLING (OWNER can't be granted via invite).

**Roles/removal** — `updateMemberRole` and `removeMember` both require OWNER/ADMIN and refuse to touch the org owner (owner role is pinned, owner can't be removed). `leaveOrg` lets any non-owner leave; the owner is told to transfer/delete instead (transfer is a follow-up).

Every mutation re-verifies the actor's membership+role in the target org via the compound unique key, so forged requests can't reach other orgs. All actions write an `auditLog` entry and `revalidatePath("/dashboard/team")`.

**Customer page** loads every org the user owns or belongs to (via their memberships), passes a flattened `OrgView[]` to `TeamManager`. Admins of an org see the member table with inline role selects, remove buttons, and the invite form; non-admins see a read-only roster; non-owners get a Leave button.

**Admin page** lists all organizations with owner (name+email) and member count using Prisma `_count`, read-only.

### INTEGRATION NEEDED (not done — not my files)
- Add a customer nav link to `/dashboard/team` (dashboard sidebar/Shell — owned by another area).
- Add an admin nav link to `/admin/orgs` under the "clients" area. Note: `lib/rbac.ts` `HREF_AREA` has no entry for `/admin/orgs`, so it currently defaults to `platform` (ADMIN-only) for nav-visibility purposes; the page itself gates correctly with `requireArea("clients")`. If SUPPORT should see the nav item, add `"/admin/orgs": "clients"` to `HREF_AREA` (rbac.ts is not mine to edit).

### Follow-ups explicitly out of scope (as instructed)
- **Shared billing** — org-level wallet/invoices/shared-membership billing is noted out of scope; no billing code touched.
- **Shared server access** — members do NOT yet inherit access to org servers; no server-ownership logic was modified.
- **Ownership transfer / org deletion** — referenced in `leaveOrg`'s message but not implemented.
- **Invitations to non-existent emails** — currently returns a "sign up first" message rather than a pending-invite record (would need a schema model, out of scope).

### Risks
- No new Prisma migration is needed — `Organization`/`Membership` models and the `User.ownedOrgs`/`memberships` relations already exist in `schema.prisma`; but the Prisma client must be regenerated/migrated by whoever owns that step for `db.organization`/`db.membership` to be available at runtime (I did not run prisma/generate per the rules).
- Membership `role` is a free-form `String` in the schema; validation is enforced only in these actions, so any other writer must uphold the same OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER/BILLING contract.
